L.title: Trước khi nghe: nghe kỹ, bắt đúng từ khóa
L.lead: Bài thi chỉ cho nghe 1 lần. Điểm Nghe đến từ việc đọc câu hỏi trước và biết mình đang chờ nghe thông tin gì, không phải nghe hiểu từng chữ.
steps: Đọc câu hỏi trước (quan trọng nhất)
Trước mỗi đoạn có 25–45 giây. Đọc câu hỏi và 4 đáp án, gạch từ hỏi: When / Where / Why / How much / Which. Biết trước mình cần nghe GIỜ, NƠI CHỐN, LÝ DO hay CON SỐ.
Dự đoán đáp án
Nhìn 4 đáp án để biết sẽ nghe gì: 4 mốc giờ thì tập trung số; 4 đồ vật thì nghe tên đồ vật. Đoán trước giúp tai không bị lạc.
Bắt từ đồng nghĩa, không chờ từ giống hệt
Đề hay nói khác đi: cheap = not expensive; a quarter past seven = 7:15; my brother's wife = sister-in-law. Đáp án đúng thường là cách nói KHÁC của điều được nghe.
Cảnh giác bẫy: đổi ý và nhắc nhiều phương án
Người nói thường nêu 2–3 lựa chọn rồi đổi ý (but / actually / I've changed my mind / it's an hour late). Đáp án thường là thông tin CUỐI CÙNG, sau chữ but/actually.
Part 2–3: ghi tắt khi nghe
Mỗi câu hỏi đi theo thứ tự đoạn nghe. Nghe xong ý cho câu 1 thì chuyển mắt sang câu 2. Ghi tắt vài chữ (số, tên, lý do).
Không bỏ trống
Lỡ câu nào thì chọn ngay đáp án hợp lý nhất rồi tập trung câu tiếp. Đừng tiếc câu cũ mà mất câu mới.
L.practice: Khi luyện trên app: (1) đọc câu hỏi 30 giây, (2) nghe 1 lần và trả lời, (3) nộp bài, (4) mở transcript, gạch câu chứa đáp án, (5) nghe lại đoạn đó 2 lần, nhìn transcript, để tai quen cách nói. Bước 4–5 mới là lúc lên điểm.

R.title: Trước khi đọc: không cần biết hết từ mới
R.lead: Anh KHÔNG cần thuộc hết từ mới trong bài. Đọc 6.5 đến từ cách tìm đúng chỗ chứa đáp án. Chỉ cần hiểu từ khóa của câu hỏi và câu chứa đáp án.
steps: Đọc câu hỏi trước, gạch từ khóa
Từ khóa dễ tìm: tên riêng, con số, năm, từ in đậm → dò thẳng trong bài. Từ khóa khó: động từ, tính từ → bài thường viết bằng từ đồng nghĩa.
Khoanh vùng: câu hỏi đi theo thứ tự bài
Câu 1 thường ở đoạn A–B, câu cuối ở đoạn cuối. Câu hỏi có ghi 'in paragraph C' thì chỉ đọc đoạn C.
Đọc 3 câu: trước – chứa từ khóa – sau
Đáp án hầu như luôn nằm trong 3 câu này. Không đọc lại cả bài.
Loại trừ trước, chọn sau
Loại đáp án: (1) bài không nhắc, (2) trái với bài, (3) đúng nhưng không trả lời câu hỏi. Đáp án đúng thường là đáp án DIỄN ĐẠT LẠI ý trong bài, không chép nguyên văn.
Ý chính nằm ở đâu

Ý chính của đoạn: câu ĐẦU (đôi khi câu cuối) của đoạn. Ý chính cả bài / best title: làm CUỐI CÙNG, sau khi các câu chi tiết đã cho anh hiểu bài; chọn đáp án bao quát cả bài, không quá hẹp, không quá rộng.
Gặp từ mới thì đoán, đừng dừng

Câu hỏi từ vựng ('closest in meaning'): thay từng đáp án vào câu trong bài, đáp án nào đọc lên hợp nghĩa thì chọn. Dấu hiệu đoán nghĩa: ví dụ sau 'such as', giải thích sau dấu phẩy, từ trái nghĩa sau 'but / unlike'.
Câu hỏi 'it / they / this' chỉ cái gì
Đọc câu NGAY TRƯỚC từ đó; danh từ gần nhất hợp số ít/số nhiều là đáp án.
Thời gian
15 phút/bài. Bài 1–2 dễ: cố đúng 7–8/10. Bài 4 khó: đúng 4/10 là đạt. Hết giờ bài nào thì đoán nốt rồi sang bài sau, không bỏ trống.
R.words: Từ mới nào nên học? Chỉ học (1) từ nằm trong câu hỏi, (2) từ nằm trong câu chứa đáp án, (3) từ lặp lại từ 2 lần trở lên trong bài. Các từ khác chỉ cần đoán đại ý.
R.practice: Khi luyện: làm bài → nộp → bấm 'Vì sao?' ở câu sai → chép từ khóa và câu chứa đáp án. Nhìn danh sách 'Từ cần nắm' ở đầu bài trước khi đọc.

W.title: Trước khi viết: viết theo khung để có điểm
W.lead: Mục tiêu trước mắt là bài đủ ý, đúng khung, câu đơn giản nhưng đúng ngữ pháp. Câu ngắn đúng được điểm cao hơn câu dài sai.
steps: Đọc đề, xác định dạng (2 phút)
Task 1: thư cho bạn → thân mật; cho công ty/sếp/hàng xóm/nhà hàng → trang trọng. Task 2: ưu – nhược / đồng ý – phản đối / 2 quan điểm / nguyên nhân – giải pháp.
Dàn ý theo gạch đầu dòng của đề (5 phút)
Đề có 3 gạch đầu dòng → 3 đoạn thân. Mỗi đoạn ghi 3–4 từ khóa tiếng Anh. Đừng viết thêm ý đề không hỏi.
Mỗi đoạn 4 câu: Ý – Giải thích – Ví dụ – Kết quả
The first advantage is that … / This is because … / For example, … / As a result, …
Câu đúng: Chủ ngữ + Động từ + …
Mỗi câu phải có động từ chia đúng (is/are/has/does). Câu dài quá 20 từ thì tách đôi. Dùng 'which' và 'If … , …' mỗi bài 1–2 lần là đủ ghi điểm.
Đúng loại từ
Sau a/the/my → DANH TỪ (the development). Trước danh từ → TÍNH TỪ (a convenient way). Bổ nghĩa động từ → TRẠNG TỪ (work effectively). Sau be/become/seem → TÍNH TỪ (it is beneficial).
Soi lỗi 5 phút cuối
Lượt 1 động từ (s/es, thì). Lượt 2 danh từ (s/es, a/an/the). Lượt 3 chính tả từ dài. Đếm đủ 120 / 250 từ.
W.practice: Mỗi đề có: dàn ý, câu khung, từ vựng kèm họ từ (danh – tính – trạng – động), và 1 bài mẫu đơn giản để 'có điểm'. Học thuộc câu khung, viết lại bằng ý của mình, rồi so với bài mẫu nâng cao trong bộ đề.

S.title: Trước khi nói: nói theo khung, ngắn mà chắc
S.lead: Nói như nói chuyện, không đọc văn. Câu ngắn, cụm từ quen miệng, mỗi ý 2–3 câu rồi DỪNG. Càng lan man càng lộ lỗi phát âm và ngữ pháp.
steps: Part 1 (3 phút, 6 câu): trả lời thẳng + 1 lý do + 1 ví dụ nhỏ
Yeah, I do. / Not really. / To be honest, … → because … → Like last weekend, I … Khoảng 15–20 giây mỗi câu, rồi dừng.
Part 2: chọn 1 – loại 2, giọng nói chuyện
I'd go for … Mainly because … Plus, … · … is OK, but … · As for …, … · So yeah, … is my pick.
Part 3: đi qua từng gợi ý bằng từ nối nói
Well, I think …, for a few reasons. · First off, … · On top of that, … · And … · Personally, I'd add … · So overall, …
Câu hỏi phụ: 2–3 câu là đủ
Yeah, definitely, because … / I'm not sure, but I'd say … / It depends. If …, then … Không giảng giải dài.
Dùng cụm có sẵn theo chủ đề
Vào mục 📚 Chủ đề: mỗi chủ đề có 8 câu nói thông dụng + hội thoại mẫu. Học thuộc cả cụm, khỏi ghép từng chữ.
Khi bí
Hmm, let me think… / That's a good question. / I've never really thought about it, but … rồi quay lại khung. Không im lặng.
S.practice: Nghe câu mẫu (🔊) → nhại lại 2 lần → che mẫu, nói bằng chuyện của mình → ghi âm và chấm.

w1.type: Thư thân mật – hủy hẹn, xin lỗi, hẹn lại
outline: Chào + mở
Dear Tom, hỏi thăm + lý do viết: phải hủy cuộc hẹn tuần sau
Đoạn 1 – Hủy & xin lỗi
I'm afraid I can't meet you … I'm really sorry.
Đoạn 2 – Lý do
Công ty có cuộc họp gấp / đi công tác; nêu 1 lý do + 1 chi tiết
Đoạn 3 – Hẹn lại
Nơi + thời gian cụ thể: café gần nhà, tối thứ Bảy sau đó
Kết
Hope you understand. Write back soon. Best wishes, Anna
sentences: I'm writing to tell you that I can't meet you next Sunday as we planned.
I'm really sorry for the short notice.
The reason is that my manager has asked me to go on a business trip.
How about meeting at … on … instead?
Please let me know if this time is OK for you.
I hope you understand.
w1.model:
Dear Tom,

I hope you are well. I'm writing to tell you that I can't meet you next Sunday as we planned. I'm really sorry for the short notice.

The reason is that my manager has asked me to go on an urgent business trip to Da Nang. I have to meet some important customers there, so I will be away from Friday to Monday.

I still really want to see you. How about meeting at the Highlands Coffee near my office on the following Saturday at 7 pm? It is quiet there, so we can talk for a long time. After that, we can have dinner together.

Please let me know if this time is OK for you. I hope you understand.

Best wishes,
Anna

w2.type: Ưu – nhược điểm (sống ở thành phố lớn)
outline: Mở bài
Ngày càng nhiều người muốn sống ở thành phố lớn → bài viết bàn cả lợi và hại
Thân 1 – Ưu điểm
(1) nhiều việc làm, lương cao; (2) trường tốt, bệnh viện tốt, giải trí
Thân 2 – Nhược điểm
(1) kẹt xe, ô nhiễm; (2) chi phí sinh hoạt cao, nhà đắt
Kết bài
Có cả lợi và hại; theo tôi lợi nhiều hơn nếu biết sắp xếp cuộc sống
sentences: In recent years, more and more people have moved to big cities to live and work.
This essay will discuss both the advantages and the disadvantages of city life.
The first advantage is that big cities offer more job opportunities with higher salaries.
On the other hand, living in a big city also has some drawbacks.
Traffic jams are common at rush hour, which wastes a lot of time.
In conclusion, although city life has some problems, I believe that its benefits are greater.
w2.model:
In recent years, more and more people have moved to big cities to live and work. City life has both advantages and disadvantages. This essay will discuss both sides.

On the one hand, living in a big city has many benefits. The first advantage is that big cities offer more job opportunities with higher salaries. This is because most large companies have their offices there. For example, many young people from my hometown find good jobs in Ho Chi Minh City. Another advantage is that cities have better facilities. People can study at good universities, go to modern hospitals and enjoy many kinds of entertainment. As a result, their quality of life can improve.

On the other hand, city life also has some drawbacks. Firstly, big cities are very crowded. Traffic jams are common at rush hour, which wastes a lot of time and causes stress. In addition, the air is polluted because of the large number of motorbikes and cars. Secondly, the cost of living is very high. Rent, food and transport are expensive, so many people find it difficult to save money.

In conclusion, living in a big city has both advantages and disadvantages. Although city life has some problems, I believe that its benefits are greater, especially for young people who want to build their careers.

w1.type: Thư thân mật – mô tả ngày yêu thích
outline: Chào + mở
Cảm ơn thư của Jane, bạn hỏi về ngày yêu thích
Đoạn 1 – Mô tả ngày đó
Chủ nhật: ngủ dậy muộn, ăn sáng với gia đình, đi cà phê
Đoạn 2 – Lý do thích
được nghỉ ngơi, có thời gian cho gia đình, hết căng thẳng
Đoạn 3 – Gợi ý làm gì
Khi Jane đến VN: cùng đi chợ, ăn phở, đạp xe công viên
Kết
Write back soon. Best wishes
sentences: Thanks for your letter. It was great to hear from you.
You asked me about my favourite day of the week, so let me tell you.
My favourite day is Sunday because I don't have to go to work.
In the morning, I usually …, and in the afternoon, I …
I like it because it helps me relax after a busy week.
If you come to Vietnam, we can spend a Sunday together.
w1.model:
Dear Jane,

Thanks for your letter. It was great to hear from you. You asked me about my favourite day of the week, so let me tell you.

My favourite day is Sunday. On Sunday morning, I usually get up late and have breakfast with my family. After that, I often go to a coffee shop and read a book. In the afternoon, I play badminton with my friends in the park.

I like Sunday because I don't have to go to work. During the week, my job is very busy and stressful, so Sunday helps me relax and recharge. It is also the only day when I can spend a lot of time with my family.

If you come to Vietnam, we can spend a Sunday together. We can eat pho for breakfast, ride bicycles around the lake and visit a local market.

Write back soon and tell me about your favourite day!

Best wishes,
Anna

w2.type: Ý kiến 1 phía – mua sắm online tích cực hay tiêu cực
outline: Mở bài
Mua sắm online ngày càng phổ biến → tôi cho rằng đây là xu hướng TÍCH CỰC
Thân 1 – Lý do 1
tiết kiệm thời gian: mua 24/7, giao tận nhà
Thân 2 – Lý do 2
rẻ hơn, dễ so sánh giá; (nhắc 1 câu mặt hạn chế: hàng giả → chọn shop uy tín)
Kết bài
Nhắc lại: tích cực, nhưng cần cẩn thận
sentences: Nowadays, online shopping has become more popular than shopping in stores.
In my opinion, this is a positive development for the following reasons.
The first reason is that online shopping saves a great deal of time.
Customers can buy things at any time, and the products are delivered to their homes.
Although some products are fake, people can avoid this by buying from reliable shops.
In conclusion, I believe that online shopping is a positive trend.
w2.model:
Nowadays, online shopping has become more popular than shopping in stores. Some people worry about this trend. However, in my opinion, it is a positive development for the following reasons.

The first reason is that online shopping saves a great deal of time. Customers can buy things at any time of the day, and the products are delivered to their homes. This is because shopping websites work 24 hours a day. For example, I often order food and clothes on my phone during my lunch break. As a result, I do not need to go to crowded shopping centres after work.

The second reason is that online shopping is often cheaper. Online shops do not have to pay for expensive buildings, so their prices are usually lower. In addition, customers can compare prices on many websites before they buy. Although some products on the Internet are fake, people can avoid this problem by buying from reliable shops and reading other customers' reviews.

In conclusion, online shopping is convenient and cheap. Therefore, I believe that it is a positive trend, but buyers should be careful when they choose a shop.

w1.type: Thư trang trọng – phàn nàn (nhà hàng)
outline: Chào + mục đích
Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about the meal last Sunday
Đoạn 1 – Thông tin
ngày, số người, giá tiền
Đoạn 2 – Vấn đề
(1) đồ ăn nguội, nhạt; (2) phục vụ chậm, thái độ không lịch sự
Đoạn 3 – Yêu cầu
hoàn lại một phần tiền / giải thích, cải thiện dịch vụ
Kết
I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully, John Smith
sentences: I am writing to complain about the meal I had at your restaurant last Sunday.
My friends and I paid 3 million VND for dinner, but we were very disappointed.
Firstly, the food was cold and it did not taste fresh.
In addition, the waiters were slow and impolite.
I would be grateful if you could give us a partial refund.
I look forward to hearing from you.
w1.model:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about the meal I had at your restaurant last Sunday evening. My four friends and I paid 3 million VND for dinner, but we were very disappointed.

Firstly, the food was not good. The steak was cold and the soup did not taste fresh. Secondly, the service was very bad. We had to wait for 45 minutes for our main dishes. When we asked the waiter about our food, he was impolite and did not say sorry.

Your restaurant is famous, so this situation was unacceptable. I would be grateful if you could give us a partial refund. I also hope that you will improve your food and service in the future.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours faithfully,
John Smith

w2.type: Ý kiến – chọn 1 phía (đi du lịch cùng bạn đồng hành)
outline: Mở bài
Có người thích đi một mình, có người thích đi cùng → tôi thích đi CÙNG bạn
Thân 1 – Lý do 1
an toàn hơn, giúp đỡ nhau khi gặp sự cố
Thân 2 – Lý do 2
vui hơn, chia sẻ kỷ niệm, chia tiền phòng/xe → tiết kiệm
Kết bài
Nhắc lại lựa chọn; đi một mình hợp với người thích tự do
sentences: Some people like to travel alone, while others prefer to travel with a companion.
Personally, I prefer travelling with a friend for two main reasons.
Firstly, travelling with a companion is safer.
If I get lost or get sick, my friend can help me.
Secondly, sharing a trip with someone makes it more enjoyable.
In conclusion, I believe that travelling with a companion is a better choice for me.
w2.model:
Some people like to travel alone, while others prefer to travel with a companion. Both ways have their own benefits. Personally, I prefer travelling with a friend for two main reasons.

Firstly, travelling with a companion is safer. When we visit a new place, we may get lost, lose our bags or get sick. If this happens, a friend can help us at once. For example, last year I had a stomach ache in Da Lat, and my friend took me to the hospital. Without him, I would have been very worried.

Secondly, sharing a trip with someone makes it more enjoyable and cheaper. We can talk, take photos of each other and create memories together. In addition, we can share the cost of hotel rooms and taxis, so the trip is less expensive. As a result, I can travel more often.

Of course, travelling alone also has advantages. It helps people become more independent and choose what they want to do.

In conclusion, I believe that travelling with a companion is a better choice for me because it is safer, more fun and cheaper.

w1.type: Thư thân mật – mời bạn đến Hà Nội

I would like to invite you to stay for a few more days after the conference.
You can stay at my house, so you don't need to book a hotel.
First, we can visit Hoan Kiem Lake and the Old Quarter.
Please let me know your flight details so that I can pick you up.
I can't wait to see you again.
w1.model:
Dear Victor,

I've just heard that you are coming to Hanoi for an international conference next month. That's great news! I would like to invite you to stay for a few more days after the conference.

You can stay at my house, so you don't need to book a hotel. First, we can visit Hoan Kiem Lake and walk around the Old Quarter. Then, I will take you to try some delicious local food, such as pho and bun cha. In the evening, we can watch a traditional water puppet show. I am sure you will love it.

Please let me know your flight details and your conference schedule so that I can pick you up. If you need any help with your visa or transport, just tell me.

I can't wait to see you again.

Best wishes,
Nam

sentences: Advertising is a common feature of our daily media.
This essay will discuss both the benefits and the drawbacks of advertising.
The first benefit is that advertisements give customers useful information about new products.
Moreover, advertising helps companies sell more products, which creates more jobs.
However, advertising also encourages people to buy things they do not really need.
In conclusion, although advertising is useful, the government should control it carefully.
w2.model:
Advertising is a common feature of our daily media. Companies spend huge amounts of money on advertisements in newspapers, on television and on the Internet. This essay will discuss both the benefits and the drawbacks of advertising.

On the one hand, advertising has several advantages. The first benefit is that advertisements give customers useful information about new products and services. For example, people can learn about a new phone or a discount at a supermarket. Moreover, advertising helps companies sell more products, which creates more jobs. What are the difficulties of learning English to adult learners?
Adults are often busy with work and family, so they have little time to practise. They are also afraid of making mistakes when they speak.

answers: When is the best time to come to your hometown? Why?
The best time to come to Ninh Thuan is from March to August. It is the dry season, so the weather is sunny and the sea is beautiful.
What do you like best about your hometown?
I like the people best. They are very friendly and helpful. Also, the food is cheap and delicious, especially seafood.
Do you think your hometown is the best place to grow up?
Yes, I think so. It is peaceful and the air is clean, so children can play outside safely. However, there are fewer good schools than in big cities.
What does your best friend look like?
My best friend is tall and slim. He has short black hair and he always wears glasses.
How did you meet your best friend?
We met at university about twenty years ago. We were in the same class and we often studied together.
In your opinion, what is the best quality of a good friend?
I think honesty is the best quality. A good friend always tells you the truth, even when it is difficult to hear.

outline: Chọn: ký túc xá
Lý do 1: rẻ, gần trường, không trễ học
Lý do 2: có bạn, học nhóm, chia sẻ tài liệu
Không chọn thuê nhà: đắt, không an toàn
Không chọn ở nhà người thân: không thoải mái, có thể xa trường
p2.model: I'd say the university hostel is the best choice. First, it's cheap, and it's right next to the school, so no long trips and no being late. Second, you make friends really quickly. You can study together and share notes, which helps a lot in the first year. Renting a flat is OK, but it costs more and it's not always safe. Staying with relatives is free, but you might not feel comfortable, and it could be far away. So I'd go for the hostel.

p3.model: I think living in the city has some clear benefits. First off, there are more jobs, and better-paid ones, because most big companies are there. On top of that, education is better. There are good schools, universities and language centres. And health care is better too, with modern hospitals and good doctors. Personally, I'd add entertainment: cinemas, malls, parks, there's always something to do. So overall, the city gives you more chances, even if it's noisy and crowded.
follow: Why do young people prefer living in the city to living in the countryside?
Because cities offer more jobs and more entertainment. Young people want to build their careers and enjoy an exciting life.
Where would you like to live? City or countryside?
I would like to work in the city, but live in the countryside when I retire, because it is quiet and the air is clean.
Does living in the countryside limit people's chances of study and work?
Yes, to some extent. There are fewer good schools and companies. However, thanks to the Internet, people can now study and work online.

answers: What did you do on your last holiday?
On my last holiday, I went to Da Lat with my family. We visited flower gardens and tried a lot of local food.
Who do you prefer spending your holiday with? Relatives or friends?
I prefer spending my holiday with my family, because I am busy at work and holidays are the best time to be together.
Do you prefer going on holiday abroad?
Sometimes. Travelling abroad helps me explore new cultures, but it is expensive, so I usually travel in Vietnam.
How many hours a day do you watch television?
I watch television for about one hour a day, usually in the evening after dinner.
Which programmes do you like?
I like the news and documentaries, because they help me keep up with current events and learn new things.
Do you prefer watching television alone or with other people? Why?
I prefer watching TV with my family, because we can talk about the programme together. It is a good way to relax after work.

outline: Chọn: mở doanh nghiệp
Lý do 1: tiền sinh ra tiền, thu nhập lâu dài
Lý do 2: tạo việc làm, dùng kinh nghiệm quản lý
Không chọn mua nhà: 1 tỷ không đủ mua nhà ở thành phố
Không chọn gửi ngân hàng: lãi suất thấp
p2.model: I'd start a business. Mainly because the money can keep growing. If it goes well, it keeps bringing in income for years, not just once. Plus, I could create jobs and use my management experience, maybe open a small training centre. Buying a house sounds nice, but 1 billion isn't enough for a house in a big city. And putting it in the bank is safe, but the interest is really low. So yeah, a business is my choice.

p3.model: Well, I think success comes from a few things. First off, education and skills. They help you get a good job and solve problems. On top of that, you need a clear vision. If you know your goal, you can plan for it. And passion matters a lot. When you love what you do, you don't give up easily. Personally, I'd add good relationships, because people around you can support you. So overall, it's knowledge, clear goals, passion and good people around you.
follow: Why is money the most common way of judging success?
Because money is easy to see and measure. People can see your house and your car, but they cannot see your happiness.
Is your idea of success the same as your parents' idea of success?
Not exactly. My parents think success means a stable job. For me, success also means doing work I love and having time for my family.
Does luck play a part in success?
Yes, luck plays a small part. However, I believe hard work is more important, because opportunities come to people who are prepared.

answers: Are clothes and clothing fashion important to you?
Clothes are quite important to me, but fashion is not. I want to look neat and professional, especially at work.
What different clothes do you wear for different situations?
At work, I wear a shirt and trousers. At home or at the weekend, I wear casual clothes, like T-shirts and jeans, because they are comfortable.
Do you wear different styles of clothes now compared to 10 years ago?
Yes, I do. Ten years ago, I wore more colourful clothes. Now I prefer simple and dark colours because they look more professional.
Do you like watching movies?
Yes, I do. I usually watch movies at the weekend to relax.
What kind of movies do you like? Why?
I like historical films, because I can learn about the past. I also enjoy comedies, because they make me laugh after a stressful week.
Who's your favourite actor or actress?
My favourite actor is Tom Hanks. He can play many different characters, and his films always have meaningful messages.

p2.pick: joining a class at an English center
outline: Chọn: lớp ở trung tâm
Lý do 1: giáo viên có chuyên môn, sửa lỗi phát âm, ngữ pháp
Lý do 2: giáo trình rõ ràng, luyện đều đặn có kỷ luật
Không chọn câu lạc bộ: không ai sửa lỗi, trình độ lẫn lộn
Không chọn nói với người nước ngoài ngoài đường: ngại, họ có thể không muốn nói chuyện
p2.model: I'd join a class at an English centre. The main reason is the teachers. They can correct my pronunciation and grammar, so I don't keep making the same mistakes. Also, there's a clear plan, so I have to practise regularly. A club is fun, but nobody really corrects you, and everyone's level is different. Talking to foreigners in the street is free, but it's awkward, and they're often busy. So a centre is my pick.

p3.model: I think team sports are really good for kids, for a few reasons. First off, they keep children fit, because they're running around a lot. On top of that, sports help them relax after long hours at school. And they make new friends while playing. Personally, I'd add teamwork and discipline. Kids learn to follow rules and work together, which helps them later at work. So overall, team sports are good for the body, the mind and social skills.
follow: Should team sports at school be compulsory?
Yes, I think they should be compulsory, maybe twice a week, because many children spend too much time on phones and computers.
Is there any disadvantage of playing team sports?
Yes. Children may get injured, and sometimes they argue when they lose. Teachers should watch them carefully.
Which team sports are popular in your country?
Football is the most popular team sport in Vietnam. Volleyball and basketball are also popular in schools.

answers: Do you like music? What kind of music do you like best? Why?
Yes, I do. I like pop music best, because it is cheerful and easy to listen to. I often listen to it while driving.
What is the most popular kind of music in your country?
I think V-pop, or Vietnamese pop music, is the most popular, especially among young people.
How is music good or not good for people?
Music is good because it helps people relax and improves their mood. However, very loud music can damage our ears.
Did you learn English at secondary school?
Yes, I did. But at that time we mainly learned grammar, so I could not speak well.
What do you think about how English is taught at school now?
It is better now. Students practise speaking and listening more, and some schools have native teachers.
In what ways has children's English improved nowadays?
Children today are more confident. They learn from YouTube, games and online resources, so their pronunciation and listening are much better.

outline: Chọn: tổ chức ở nhà
Lý do 1: tiết kiệm, tự nấu món mình thích
Lý do 2: thoải mái, ấm cúng, không giới hạn thời gian
Không chọn nhà hàng: đắt, phải đặt trước
Không chọn karaoke: ồn, khó nói chuyện
p2.model: I'd have the party at home. First, it's cheaper. I can cook the dishes I like with my family. Second, it's cosy. My friends can stay as long as they want and we can really talk. A restaurant is nice, but it's expensive and you have to book. Karaoke is fun, but it's way too loud to chat. So home is the best option for me.

p3.model: I think there are a few simple ways to stay healthy. First off, exercise regularly, like jogging or swimming a few times a week. On top of that, try to reduce stress. Listen to music, spend time with your family after work. And eat well: more vegetables and fruit, less junk food. Personally, I'd add sleep. Seven or eight hours a night makes a big difference. So overall, move more, stress less, eat well and sleep enough.
follow: Do you think people pay enough attention to their health today?
Not enough. Many people are too busy with work, so they eat fast food and do not exercise.
How can people be encouraged to stay healthy?
The government can build more parks and sports centres, and companies can give staff time to exercise.
Do you think most people worry more about their health as they get older?
Yes, I think so. When people get older, they have more health problems, so they pay more attention to their health.

answers: Would you like to live where there is always snow?
No, I wouldn't. I grew up in a hot place, so I think I would feel too cold and uncomfortable.
Which do you like better: hot weather or cold weather?
I like cool weather better, like in Da Lat, because I can work and sleep well.
Do you think weather affects the way people feel?
Yes, I do. When it is sunny, people feel happy. When it rains for many days, people often feel sad and lazy.
What's your job?
I am the head of the external relations department in an education and human resources company. I manage a team of ten people.
Do you enjoy your job?
Yes, I do. It is challenging, but rewarding, because I help students find jobs in Japan.
Do you prefer working alone or with others? Why?
I prefer working with others, because we can share ideas and finish work faster. However, I work alone when I need to concentrate.

p2.pick: a gifted school far from home
outline: Chọn: trường chuyên xa nhà
Lý do 1: giáo viên giỏi, bạn bè giỏi → phát triển năng lực
Lý do 2: học cách tự lập, vẫn ở Việt Nam nên gia đình thăm được
Không chọn du học Úc: đắt, còn nhỏ, sốc văn hóa
Không chọn trường công gần nhà: chương trình chung, không phát huy hết tài năng
p2.model: I'd choose the gifted school far from home. Mainly because the teachers and classmates are excellent, so he can really develop his talent. Plus, living away from home makes him more independent, but he's still in Vietnam, so we can visit easily. Studying in Australia is great, but it's very expensive and he's too young to be alone abroad. The local public school is convenient, but it might not be challenging enough. So the gifted school is my pick.

vocab: no need to find a parking space
p3.model: I think public transport is a smart choice, for a few reasons. First off, it's cheap. A bus ticket costs much less than petrol and parking. On top of that, it's better for the environment, because one bus carries lots of people. And it helps cut down traffic jams. Personally, I'd add that it's less stressful. You can read or rest instead of fighting the traffic. So overall, it saves money, helps the environment and reduces traffic.
follow: What means of public transport are popular where you live?
Buses are the most popular. Recently, the metro line in Ho Chi Minh City has also become popular.
Is public transport more convenient than private transport?
Not yet in Vietnam. Buses are sometimes slow and do not go everywhere, so many people still prefer motorbikes.
Will public transport be popular in the future?
Yes, I think so. The government is building more metro lines, and people care more about the environment.

answers: Do you like walking? When and where do you walk?
Yes, I do. I usually go for a walk in the park near my house after dinner, for about thirty minutes.
Do you think walking is important?
Yes, I think it is very important. It is free and easy, and it is good for our heart and our mind.
Is walking in the countryside better than walking in the city?
Yes, I think so. The countryside has fresh air and it is quiet, while the city is noisy and full of motorbikes.
Do you often eat healthy food?
I try to. I eat a lot of vegetables and fish, but sometimes I eat fast food when I am busy.
What do you usually eat at work?
At work, I usually have rice with meat and vegetables from a canteen near my office.
What is the unhealthiest food you can think of?
I think fried chicken and French fries are the unhealthiest, because they have a lot of fat and salt.

outline: Chọn: sách
Lý do 1: ý nghĩa, dùng lâu dài, mở mang kiến thức
Lý do 2: giá hợp lý, dễ chọn theo sở thích bạn
Không chọn vé ca nhạc: đắt, chỉ một tối, phải hợp gu
Không chọn phiếu mua sắm: thiếu tình cảm, giống đưa tiền
p2.model: I'd go for a book. First, it lasts a long time, and every time my friend reads it, he'll think of me. Second, books aren't expensive, and I can pick one on a topic he loves, so it feels personal. A music show ticket is nice, but it's pricey and it's just one night. A shopping coupon is practical, but it's a bit like giving money. So a book is my choice.

p3.model: Well, I think cheap flights are a good thing overall. First off, they let more people travel, visit family and do business, and that helps tourism. But there are some problems. Flights are often delayed, the seats are small, and you pay extra for bags. More flights also mean more pollution. Personally, I think cheap tickets should be mainly for domestic flights, because that's where most people travel. So overall, cheap flights are useful, as long as they're safe and on time.
follow: Should learning English be compulsory at school?
Yes, I think so, because English is necessary for study and work in the future.
What second languages are popular in your country?
Japanese, Korean and Chinese are popular, because many companies from these countries invest in Vietnam.
What are the difficulties of learning English for adult learners?
Adults are busy and have little time to practise. They also feel shy when they make mistakes.

answers: Do you like singing?
Yes, I do, but I can't sing very well. I only sing for fun with my friends.
When was the last time you sang?
The last time I sang was at my company's year-end party last month. We sang karaoke together.
Have you ever had singing lessons?
No, I haven't. I am too busy, but I think singing lessons would be interesting.
What game did you enjoy playing when you were a child?
When I was a child, I enjoyed flying kites and playing hide and seek.
Who did you play with?
I played with my brother and the children in my neighbourhood, usually in the afternoon after school.
Did you need any skills to play the game?
Yes, a little. To fly a kite, you need to understand the wind, and for hide and seek you need to be quick and quiet.

outline: Chọn: biển
Lý do 1: thư giãn sau công việc căng thẳng, tắm biển, hải sản
Lý do 2: phù hợp mọi lứa tuổi, cả gia đình
Không chọn leo núi: mệt, nguy hiểm
Không chọn tham quan: đi nhiều, đông khách
p2.model: I'd pick a beach holiday. Mainly because I just want to relax. After a busy year, I'd love to swim, lie on the beach and eat fresh seafood. Plus, it suits everyone, so my whole family can enjoy it. A climbing holiday sounds exciting, but it's tiring and a bit dangerous. Sightseeing is interesting, but you walk all day and it's crowded. So the beach is my choice.

p3.model: I think music should definitely be taught at school. First off, it helps students relax. After a hard maths lesson, a music class is a nice break. On top of that, it improves memory, because you have to remember songs and rhythms. And it helps with language and thinking skills. Personally, I'd add creativity and teamwork, when students sing or play together. So overall, music lessons are good for both the mind and the mood.
follow: Should children be encouraged to learn music early?
Yes. Young children learn quickly, and music helps their brains develop. But parents should not force them.
Do you agree that music can change people's moods?
Yes, I agree. Happy songs make me feel energetic, while slow songs help me calm down.
What would life be like without music?
Life would be boring and quiet. Parties, films and even shops would feel empty without music.

answers: Do you like to live in a noisy place or a quiet place?
I prefer a quiet place, because I need to rest well after a busy working day.
What kind of noise disturbs you most?
Construction noise disturbs me most, especially early in the morning, because it is loud and lasts for hours.
Does noise affect your health?
Yes, it does. Too much noise makes me stressed and gives me headaches. It can also disturb my sleep.
What is your favourite photograph?
My favourite photograph is a picture of my whole family on Tet holiday in my hometown.
When was it taken?
It was taken about five years ago, in front of my parents' house.
What makes the photograph special to you?
It is special because everyone in my family is in it, and we rarely meet all together now.

outline: Chọn: đi chơi với bạn
Lý do 1: giảm căng thẳng, vui
Lý do 2: giữ tình bạn, chia sẻ kinh nghiệm công việc
Không chọn đọc sách: tốt nhưng đọc một mình, có thể đọc trước khi ngủ
Không chọn lướt mạng: tốn thời gian, hại mắt
p2.model: I'd say hanging out with friends. First, it helps me relax after a long day. We just talk, eat and laugh. Second, it keeps our friendship strong. We share stories and give each other advice. Reading is a good habit, but I can do that alone before bed. Surfing the Internet? People waste hours, and it's bad for your eyes. So hanging out is my pick.

p3.model: I think there are lots of ways to make friends. First off, go to social events, like workshops or community activities. You meet new people there. On top of that, join a group with the same interests, a running club or a book club, for example. It's easy to chat when you like the same things. And parties are good too, you meet friends of friends. Personally, I'd add volunteering. You work together for a good cause, so you get close quickly. So overall, just be active and open.
follow: Should people trust online friends?
Not completely. Some people online are not honest about themselves, so we should be careful and meet in public places first.
What factors can contribute to a true friendship?
Honesty, trust and support. True friends help each other in difficult times.
Which one is more important: family or friends?
For me, family is more important, because they are always there for me. But friends are also important for my happiness.

answers: What colours do you like most?
I like dark blue most, because it looks calm and professional.
Do you care about colours when choosing clothes?
Yes, I do. I choose colours that match each other and suit the situation, for example dark colours for meetings.
Does colour affect your mood?
Yes, I think so. Bright colours like yellow make me feel cheerful, while grey makes me feel a bit sad.
How often do you go to the library?
I rarely go to the library now, maybe once or twice a month, because I am busy.
What do you usually do in the library?
I usually borrow books about management and study for my MBA there, because it is quiet.
Do you think fewer people go to the library nowadays?
Yes. Many people now read e-books and search for information on the Internet, so they do not need to go to the library.

outline: Chọn: nhà hàng ngồi bàn
Lý do 1: không phải nấu, dọn dẹp; có người phục vụ
Lý do 2: không gian lịch sự, đồ ăn ngon, chụp ảnh đẹp
Không chọn đồ ăn nhanh: ồn, đồ ăn không tốt cho sức khỏe
Không chọn ở nhà: mệt vì chuẩn bị, dọn dẹp
p2.model: I'd go for a sit-down restaurant. Mainly because I don't have to cook or clean. The staff do everything, so I can actually enjoy the party. Plus, it's comfortable, the food's good, and we can take nice photos. Fast food is cheap, but it's noisy and not very healthy. Having it at home saves money, but it's tiring to prepare and clean up afterwards. So a restaurant is my choice.

p3.model: I think more recycling centres are a great idea, for a few reasons. First off, they reduce the amount of rubbish going to landfills, so there's less pollution. On top of that, waste can be turned into new products, which saves resources. And they create jobs for local people. Personally, I'd add that they make people more aware of the environment. So overall, they're good for the environment, the economy and the community.
follow: Are you aware of what recycling means?
Yes. Recycling means turning used things, like paper, plastic and metal, into new products.
Do you recycle as part of your everyday life?
Yes, a little. My family sorts plastic bottles and paper and gives them to collectors.
Do you agree that everyone should reuse and recycle products?
Yes, I agree. If everyone does a little, we can reduce a lot of waste and protect the environment.

late: the late Mr X = đã mất
venture: dự án kinh doanh mạo hiểm
hasn't gone to his head: không làm anh ta kiêu ngạo
precious charges: những đứa con quý giá (người được chăm sóc)
charge = người được giao chăm sóc

write.eg: Should learning English be compulsory at primary school?
outline: Mở bài
English is important nowadays → tôi đồng ý / bài bàn 2 mặt
Thân 1
Lợi ích: job opportunities · communicate with foreigners · access information online
Thân 2
Khó khăn / giải pháp: lack of qualified teachers · too much pressure → trường cần giáo viên giỏi, học qua trò chơi
Kết bài
Nhắc lại quan điểm + 1 lời khuyên
vocab: cải thiện kỹ năng ngôn ngữ
sentences: Education plays an important role in our lives.
Students should learn practical skills as well as theory.
Online learning is flexible and affordable, but students need to be self-disciplined.

chunks: To be honest, I wasn't very good at English at school.
Thật lòng mà nói, hồi đi học tôi không giỏi tiếng Anh lắm.
Back then, we mostly learned grammar.
Hồi đó chủ yếu học ngữ pháp.
Now kids learn it in a much more fun way.
Giờ trẻ con học vui hơn nhiều.
It's really useful for my job.
Nó rất có ích cho công việc của tôi.
The hardest part for me is speaking.
Khó nhất với tôi là phần nói.
I try to practise a bit every day.
Tôi cố luyện một chút mỗi ngày.
I think it depends on the teacher.
Tôi nghĩ còn tùy giáo viên.
Kids pick it up really fast.
Trẻ con học rất nhanh.
dialogue: Do you think English should be taught early?
Yeah, definitely. Kids pick up languages really fast. And it gives them more chances later on.
What's difficult about learning English for adults?
Mainly time, I'd say. We're busy with work and family. Also, we're a bit shy about making mistakes.
How do you practise English?
I watch YouTube in English and try to speak a little every evening. Not much, but every day.

write.eg: Machines are replacing human workers. What problems does this cause and what are the solutions?
outline: Mở bài
Technology is changing the way we work → bài nêu vấn đề + giải pháp
Thân 1 – vấn đề
unemployment · lower income · stress / the gap between rich and poor
Thân 2 – giải pháp
retrain workers · teach technology skills at school · financial support
Kết bài
We can't stop technology, but we can prepare
vocab: cân bằng công việc – cuộc sống
đào tạo lại người lao động
sentences: Many people find it hard to keep a good work-life balance.
Companies should provide training so that employees can develop their skills.
Working from home saves time, but it can make people feel isolated.

chunks: I work in education and human resources.
Tôi làm trong lĩnh vực giáo dục và nhân sự.
I manage a small team.
Tôi quản lý một nhóm nhỏ.
It's busy, but I like it.
Bận, nhưng tôi thích.
The best part is helping students find jobs.
Điều tôi thích nhất là giúp sinh viên tìm việc.
The downside is the long hours.
Mặt trừ là làm nhiều giờ.
I'd rather work in a team.
Tôi thích làm theo nhóm hơn.
It really depends on the task.
Còn tùy công việc.
That's the main reason I chose this job.
Đó là lý do chính tôi chọn nghề này.
dialogue: What do you do?
I work for an education company. I'm in charge of partnerships with universities.
Do you enjoy your job?
Yes, most of the time. It's busy, but it's rewarding when students get good jobs.
Do you prefer working alone or with others?
With others, I think. We share ideas and get things done faster. But for paperwork, I prefer to work alone.

topics.vi: Công nghệ – Internet – mạng xã hội

write.eg: Online shopping is more popular than in-store shopping. Is it positive or negative?
outline: Mở bài
Technology has changed our daily life → tôi cho rằng tích cực (hoặc 2 mặt)
Thân 1 – lợi
save time · convenient 24/7 · compare prices · access information
Thân 2 – hại / giải pháp
addiction · less face-to-face contact · fake information / scams → dùng có giới hạn, chọn nguồn tin cậy
Kết bài
Useful if we use it wisely
sentences: The Internet allows us to access information at any time.
However, spending too much time online can lead to addiction.
Parents should limit their children's screen time.

chunks: I use my phone for almost everything.
Tôi dùng điện thoại cho gần như mọi thứ.
I can't live without the Internet.
Tôi không sống thiếu Internet được.
It saves me a lot of time.
Nó giúp tôi tiết kiệm nhiều thời gian.
I try not to spend too much time on social media.
Tôi cố không dùng mạng xã hội quá nhiều.
Kids these days are on their phones all the time.
Trẻ con giờ cầm điện thoại suốt.
It's handy, but it can be addictive.
Tiện, nhưng dễ nghiện.
I mostly use it for work.
Tôi chủ yếu dùng cho công việc.
You have to be careful with fake news.
Phải cẩn thận với tin giả.
dialogue: How often do you use the Internet?
Pretty much all day. For work, emails, news… everything really.
Is technology good for children?
It's useful for learning, but they shouldn't use it too much. An hour a day is enough, I think.
Do you shop online?
Yeah, quite often. It's quick and cheap, and they deliver to my door.

topics.name: Environment
topics.vi: Môi trường – rác thải – ô nhiễm
topics.tests: T10 Nói P3 (tái chế) · T6 Nói P3 (giao thông công cộng) · T7 Viết T2 (thuế xe hơi)

write.eg: What are the causes of pollution in big cities and how can we solve it?
outline: Mở bài
Pollution is a serious problem → bài nêu nguyên nhân + giải pháp
Thân 1 – nguyên nhân
too many vehicles · factories · plastic waste / people's habits
Thân 2 – giải pháp
public transport · strict laws · recycling · raise awareness
Kết bài
Government + individuals must act together
sentences: The main cause of air pollution is the large number of motorbikes.
The government should invest more in public transport.
Everyone can help by using fewer plastic bags.

chunks: The air in the city is really bad these days.
Không khí thành phố dạo này tệ lắm.
Traffic is the main problem.
Giao thông là vấn đề chính.
My family sorts our rubbish at home.
Nhà tôi phân loại rác.
I try to use fewer plastic bags.
Tôi cố dùng ít túi ni lông.
Small changes can make a big difference.
Thay đổi nhỏ cũng tạo khác biệt lớn.
The government needs to do more.
Chính phủ cần làm nhiều hơn.
It's everyone's job, not just the government's.
Đó là việc của mọi người, không chỉ chính phủ.
If we don't act now, it'll get worse.
Không làm ngay thì sẽ tệ hơn.
dialogue: Do you recycle?
Yes, a bit. We keep plastic bottles and paper separate and give them to collectors.
What's the biggest environmental problem in your city?
Air pollution, for sure. There are just too many motorbikes.
What can people do?
Simple things, really. Take the bus, use fewer plastic bags, turn off the lights.

topics.name: Health & Lifestyle
topics.vi: Sức khỏe – lối sống – thể dục
topics.tests: T1 Nói P1 (giữ dáng) · T5 Nói P3 (lối sống lành mạnh) · T5 Viết T2 (cấm hút thuốc) · T7 Nói P1 (đi bộ, ăn uống) · T9 Viết T2 (đồ ăn nhanh)

write.eg: What should people do to have a healthy lifestyle?
outline: Mở bài
More people care about health, but many still live unhealthily
Thân 1
exercise regularly · balanced diet (more vegetables, less fast food)
Thân 2
reduce stress · enough sleep · regular check-ups
Kết bài
Small daily habits → long-term health
sentences: Doing exercise regularly helps us keep fit and reduce stress.
Fast food contains a lot of fat and salt, so it can lead to obesity.
Office workers should avoid sitting for too long.

chunks: I try to go jogging three times a week.
Tôi cố chạy bộ 3 lần/tuần.
I'm not as fit as I used to be.
Tôi không còn khỏe như trước.
I eat a lot of vegetables.
Tôi ăn nhiều rau.
When I'm busy, I just grab some fast food.
Lúc bận tôi ăn tạm đồ ăn nhanh.
Walking after dinner helps me relax.
Đi bộ sau bữa tối giúp tôi thư giãn.
Sleep is really important for me.
Ngủ rất quan trọng với tôi.
It's easier said than done.
Nói thì dễ, làm mới khó.
I should do more exercise, to be honest.
Thật ra tôi nên tập nhiều hơn.
dialogue: How often do you exercise?
About three times a week. Usually jogging in the park in the morning.
Do you eat healthy food?
I try to. Lots of vegetables and fish. But when I'm busy, I eat whatever's quick.
Do people care about their health more as they get older?
Yeah, definitely. When you're young, you think you're fine. Later, you start to worry.

topics.name: City, Countryside & Transport
topics.vi: Thành phố – nông thôn – giao thông
topics.tests: T1 Viết T2 (sống ở thành phố) · T2 Nói P1 (quê hương), P3 (lợi ích thành phố) · T6 Nói P3 (giao thông công cộng) · T7 Viết T2 · T9 Nói P1 (tiếng ồn)

write.eg: Some people prefer to live in the city, others in the countryside. Discuss both views.
outline: Mở bài
City life and country life both have advantages → bàn 2 mặt + ý kiến
Thân 1 – thành phố
more jobs · better schools & hospitals · entertainment (nhưng kẹt xe, ô nhiễm, đắt)
Thân 2 – nông thôn
fresh air · peaceful · cheaper · close community (nhưng ít việc, ít dịch vụ)
Kết bài
Theo tôi: trẻ thì thành phố, về hưu thì quê
vocab: cơ sở vật chất hiện đại
sentences: Big cities offer more job opportunities and better facilities.
However, the cost of living in cities is very high.
The countryside is peaceful and the air is much fresher.

chunks: I'm from Ninh Thuan, a small province by the sea.
Tôi quê Ninh Thuận, tỉnh nhỏ ven biển.
It's quiet and the people are really friendly.
Yên tĩnh và người rất thân thiện.
Traffic in Saigon drives me crazy.
Kẹt xe ở Sài Gòn làm tôi phát điên.
It takes me about 40 minutes to get to work.
Tôi mất khoảng 40 phút đi làm.
City life is exciting, but it's tiring.
Sống thành phố vui nhưng mệt.
I'd love to move back to the countryside one day.
Một ngày nào đó tôi muốn về quê sống.
There's more to do in the city.
Ở thành phố có nhiều thứ để làm hơn.
Buses here aren't very convenient yet.
Xe buýt ở đây chưa tiện lắm.
dialogue: Where's your hometown?
Ninh Thuan, in the south-central coast. It's famous for grapes and beautiful beaches.
Would you rather live in the city or the countryside?
Right now, the city, because of work. But when I retire, definitely the countryside.
How do you usually get to work?
By motorbike. It's quicker than the bus, but the traffic is terrible at rush hour.

topics.name: Travel & Holidays
topics.tests: T3 Nói P1 (kỳ nghỉ) · T3 Viết T2 (đi du lịch với bạn) · T4 Viết T1 (mời bạn đến Hà Nội) · T7 Nói P3 (vé máy bay giá rẻ) · T8 Viết T1, Nói P2 (kỳ nghỉ)

write.eg: Is it better to travel alone or with a companion?
outline: Mở bài
Travel is popular → nêu lựa chọn của tôi
Thân 1
Lý do 1: safety / help each other (hoặc tự do nếu chọn đi một mình)
Thân 2
Lý do 2: share memories & costs; nhắc 1 câu mặt kia
Kết bài
Nhắc lại lựa chọn
sentences: Travelling helps people relax and broaden their horizons.
When I travel with friends, we can share the cost of hotels and taxis.
Cheap flights make it easier for people to visit their families.

chunks: I usually travel with my family.
Tôi thường đi du lịch với gia đình.
Last summer we went to Da Lat.
Hè rồi nhà tôi đi Đà Lạt.
We just relaxed and ate a lot.
Chỉ nghỉ ngơi và ăn thật nhiều.
I prefer the beach to the mountains.
Tôi thích biển hơn núi.
It's too expensive to go abroad often.
Đi nước ngoài thường xuyên thì đắt quá.
I'd love to visit Japan one day.
Tôi rất muốn đi Nhật một lần.
The best part was the food.
Hay nhất là đồ ăn.
It was a bit tiring, but worth it.
Hơi mệt nhưng đáng.
dialogue: What did you do on your last holiday?
I went to Da Lat with my family. We visited some flower gardens and ate a lot of street food.
Do you prefer to travel alone or with others?
With others. It's safer and more fun. Plus, you can split the cost.
Where would you like to go in the future?
Japan, for sure. I work with Japanese partners, so I'd love to see the country myself.

topics.name: Family, Friends & Society
topics.vi: Gia đình – bạn bè – xã hội
topics.tests: T2 Nói P1 (bạn thân) · T9 Nói P2 (buổi tối), P3 (kết bạn) · T10 Viết T1 (xin lỗi hàng xóm), T2 (tội phạm trẻ)

write.eg: Youth crime is increasing in big cities. What are the causes and solutions?
outline: Mở bài
Vấn đề xã hội ngày càng nghiêm trọng → nguyên nhân + giải pháp
Thân 1 – nguyên nhân
parents too busy · bad influence (friends, violent games) · drop out of school
Thân 2 – giải pháp
parents spend time · schools teach life skills · youth clubs, vocational training
Kết bài
Family + school + government work together
sentences: Parents should spend more quality time with their children.
Teenagers are easily influenced by their friends.
True friends support each other in difficult times.

chunks: We've been friends for about twenty years.
Chúng tôi là bạn khoảng 20 năm rồi.
We met at university.
Chúng tôi quen nhau ở đại học.
He's always there when I need help.
Lúc tôi cần là anh ấy luôn có mặt.
We don't meet often, but we keep in touch.
Không gặp thường xuyên nhưng vẫn giữ liên lạc.
For me, family comes first.
Với tôi, gia đình là trên hết.
We usually have dinner together at weekends.
Cuối tuần chúng tôi thường ăn tối cùng nhau.
Honesty is the most important thing.
Trung thực là quan trọng nhất.
It's hard to make close friends as an adult.
Lớn rồi khó kết bạn thân.
dialogue: How did you meet your best friend?
At university. We were in the same class and studied together a lot.
What makes a good friend?
Honesty, mainly. Someone who tells you the truth, even when it's hard to hear.
Family or friends – which is more important?
Family, for me. But friends matter too. You need both, really.

topics.name: Shopping, Money & Advertising
topics.vi: Mua sắm – tiền bạc – quảng cáo
topics.tests: T1 Nói P2 (mua quần áo) · T2 Viết T2 (mua online) · T3 Nói P2 (1 tỷ đồng) · T4 Viết T2 (quảng cáo), Nói P1 (quần áo) · T7 Nói P2 (quà sinh nhật)

outline: Mở bài
Ads are everywhere → bàn lợi và hại
Thân 1 – lợi
inform customers · help businesses sell · pay for free media
Thân 2 – hại
buy things they don't need · misleading · bad for children
Kết bài
Useful but should be controlled
sentences: Advertisements give customers useful information about new products.
However, they often encourage people to buy things they do not need.
Shoppers should compare prices before they buy.

chunks: I'm not really into shopping.
Tôi không mê mua sắm lắm.
I usually buy clothes online.
Tôi thường mua quần áo online.
It's cheaper and I don't have to go out.
Rẻ hơn và không phải ra ngoài.
I like to try things on first.
Tôi thích mặc thử trước.
I'd go for something useful.
Tôi sẽ chọn thứ gì đó hữu ích.
It's a bit pricey, but it's good quality.
Hơi đắt nhưng chất lượng tốt.
I'd save some and invest the rest.
Tôi sẽ để dành một phần, đầu tư phần còn lại.
Ads can be really annoying.
Quảng cáo nhiều khi rất phiền.
dialogue: Do you like shopping?
Not really. I only buy what I need. Mostly online, because it's quicker.
Which is the best place to buy clothes?
I'd say online shops. Cheaper, more choice, and they deliver. Markets are fine, but too crowded.
What would you do with 1 billion dong?
Honestly? I'd start a small business, maybe a training centre. Putting it in the bank doesn't earn much.

topics.name: Entertainment: Music, Films, TV
topics.vi: Giải trí – âm nhạc – phim – truyền hình
topics.tests: T3 Nói P1 (TV) · T4 Nói P1 (phim) · T5 Nói P1 (âm nhạc) · T8 Nói P1 (hát), P3 (nhạc ở trường) · T10 Nói P1 (màu sắc, thư viện)

write.eg: Music should be taught in schools. Do you agree?
outline: Mở bài
Music is part of our life → tôi đồng ý
Thân 1
reduce stress · improve memory & creativity
Thân 2
teamwork when playing together · discover talents (nhắc: không ép, không quá nhiều giờ)
Kết bài
Nhắc lại đồng ý
sentences: Music helps students relax after long hours of studying.
Watching the news helps people keep up with current events.
Some TV programmes contain violent content which is bad for children.

chunks: I'm a big fan of pop music.
Tôi rất thích nhạc pop.
I listen to music when I drive.
Tôi nghe nhạc khi lái xe.
I can't sing very well, to be honest.
Thật ra tôi hát không hay.
I mostly watch the news and documentaries.
Tôi chủ yếu xem thời sự và phim tài liệu.
It helps me unwind after work.
Nó giúp tôi thư giãn sau giờ làm.
I don't really watch TV these days.
Dạo này tôi hầu như không xem TV.
I'd rather watch it at home.
Tôi thích xem ở nhà hơn.
It puts me in a good mood.
Nó làm tôi vui lên.
dialogue: What kind of music do you like?
Mostly pop, and some old Vietnamese songs. Something easy to listen to.
How often do you watch TV?
Not much, about an hour in the evening. Usually the news.
Can music change your mood?
Oh, definitely. Happy songs wake me up. Slow ones help me calm down.

topics.name: Food & Eating
topics.vi: Ẩm thực – thói quen ăn uống
topics.tests: T7 Nói P1 (thói quen ăn uống) · T9 Viết T2 (đồ ăn nhanh) · T10 Nói P2 (tổ chức sinh nhật) · T3 Viết T1 (phàn nàn nhà hàng) · T5 Nói P2 (tiệc)

write.eg: Fast food: convenient for busy people or harmful to health?
outline: Mở bài
Fast food is popular → tôi cho rằng nên hạn chế
Thân 1 – công nhận mặt kia
quick, cheap, convenient
Thân 2 – lý do chính
fat, sugar, salt → obesity, heart disease; có lựa chọn khác lành mạnh
Kết bài
Eat it only occasionally
sentences: Fast food is quick and cheap, so it is popular with busy people.
Home-cooked meals are healthier because we can choose fresh ingredients.
People should eat fast food only occasionally.

chunks: I'm not a fussy eater.
Tôi không kén ăn.
I usually have rice for lunch at work.
Trưa ở công ty tôi thường ăn cơm.
I love seafood – it's cheap in my hometown.
Tôi mê hải sản – ở quê tôi rẻ lắm.
I try to cut down on sugar.
Tôi cố bớt ăn đường.
We eat out at weekends.
Cuối tuần chúng tôi đi ăn ngoài.
Home-cooked food is the best.
Đồ nhà nấu là ngon nhất.
It's tasty, but not very healthy.
Ngon nhưng không tốt lắm.
My favourite dish is bun cha.
Món tôi thích nhất là bún chả.
dialogue: Do you eat healthy food?
I try to, but not always. When I'm busy, I just grab a banh mi.
What do you usually eat at work?
Rice with meat and vegetables from a canteen near my office. Simple, but filling.
What's the unhealthiest food you can think of?
Fried chicken and fries, I think. Way too much oil.

topics.name: Sports, Hobbies & Free Time

write.eg: Should team sports be compulsory at school?
outline: Mở bài
Children spend too much time on screens → tôi đồng ý
Thân 1
keep fit · relax after studying
Thân 2
teamwork & discipline · make friends (nhắc: tránh chấn thương, giáo viên giám sát)
Kết bài
Nhắc lại đồng ý
sentences: Team sports teach children how to work in a team.
Playing sports is a great way to relax after school.
Teachers should watch students carefully to avoid injuries.

chunks: I play badminton twice a week.
Tôi chơi cầu lông 2 lần/tuần.
I'm not very sporty, to be honest.
Thật ra tôi không giỏi thể thao lắm.
In my free time, I just stay home and read.
Lúc rảnh tôi chỉ ở nhà đọc sách.
When I was a kid, I used to fly kites.
Hồi nhỏ tôi hay thả diều.
It's a great way to unwind.
Đó là cách thư giãn rất tốt.
Football is huge in Vietnam.
Bóng đá cực kỳ phổ biến ở Việt Nam.
I wish I had more time for it.
Ước gì tôi có nhiều thời gian hơn cho nó.
I'm trying to get back into it.
Tôi đang cố chơi lại.
dialogue: Do you play any sports?
Yeah, badminton, a couple of times a week after work. It keeps me fit.
What did you play as a child?
Hide and seek, and flying kites with the kids in my neighbourhood. Good memories.
Should sports be compulsory at school?
I think so, maybe twice a week. Kids spend way too much time on their phones.
